comparison.objective: Clamp a blank with an eccentric cam, versus commission and lock a shock absorber by tuning its dynamic stopping response.
comparison.physical_skill: Cam actuation and blank restraint versus hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, counterholding, torque-limited locking, and test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Blank clamped versus two safe, repeatable ≥0.85 J stops within stroke/rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both rotate a retention mechanism, but the candidate uniquely tests iterative dynamic damping and retained adjustment. The record has no specs, so its detailed clamp thresholds are missing.
